column3: the same for Winter Is Coming's warmth patch (Nexus 19154 file 66093): 183 ARMO overrides, no record of its own

its 805 HDPT overrides (766 of Skyrim.esm, 39 of Dawnguard.esm) clear the gender bits (DATA 01/05/09/11/18/19) to make every part playable for every race; RaceMenu's ApplyPresetData applies a part only when its gender flag matches the actor, so under the layer every preset load seated the race defaults for hair, hairline, beard, brows and marks (thuum-magnus, a-racemenu red 20261020-193623; Eli: "patch it"). The first patch set both bits, which fixed the preset load (x-layer-headparts 20261020-210719) and broke the vanilla menu's rebuild for males, which reads a part with the female bit as female and took the first valid alternative, ApachiiHairM01 (a-racemenu 20261020-224305 step 18). Each override now carries its master record's own gender bits, right for both paths; the all-races RNAM stays. HYPOTHESIS until a-racemenu is green on the render

column1: Supernatural Survival Tweaks - Cold Resist Werebeast and Vampire.esp
column3: the only layer plugin overriding the player's base record NPC_ 0x00000007: a whole copy of the vanilla Player (Prisoner, NordRace, male, one head part, vanilla spells, perks, inventory, tints) plus a VMAD attaching SST_PlayerScriptAddRemoveAbilities, the script that gives vampires and werebeasts their cold resist. In SkyMP every player shares 0x7 and the server builds each player from it, so no served plugin may override it (nor PlayerRef 0x14; layer-stage's 2b refuses one); the a-rotfern CTD of 2026-10-20 (SkyrimSE.exe+095A263, run 20261020-224918) had this override on the stack under the mid-game look. The override's script never ran connected (outside the admitted list), so nothing that worked is lost; the plugin's Survival quest, effect and spell overrides stay. thuum-magnus's rule and ask, 2026-10-20; Eli, 2026-10-20: "patch it"

RaceCompatibility's PlayerVampireQuestScript turns and cures by index: PlayableRaceList[i] pairs with PlayableVampireList[i]. rotfern.esp's override of PlayableRaceList (RaceCompatibility.esm 000D62) carried 15 entries, the ten vanilla races, then four non-playable child races at [10..13] and rotfern at [14], while its PlayableVampireList override had 12, so a turn asked for VampireList[14] (none, no race set) and a cure from rotfernRaceVampire ([11]) gave ImperialRaceChild (docs/research/vampirism-under-the-server.md; the 2026-10-06 diff in docs/MODS.md). Now the ten vanilla races in RaceCompatibility's order and rotfern at [10]. Eli's call D57 A, 2026-10-28 ("rotfern's vampire pairing fixed in our layer"); the plugin is Eli's and is never edited here, so the served copy carries the fix

the vampire half of the same pairing: the ten vanilla vampire races in RaceCompatibility's order (Argonian, Breton, Dark Elf, High Elf, Imperial, Khajiit, Nord, Orc, Redguard, Wood Elf) and rotfernRaceVampire at [10], BretonRaceChildVampire dropped from [10]. Both rows together change rotfern.esp's size (99,409 B before) and so its CRC32 for the slot's mod-lock, on every client and the server alike
